site_tagline: Documentation for building, running, and extending a hub.
site_description: Hubzero is an open source platform for scientific collaboration websites. These books cover installing and administering a hub, using one, and developing components, plugins, modules, and templates for the Hubzero CMS.

books.title: Hub managers
books.summary: Installing a hub, then running it: configuration, members and access, content, extensions, and maintenance.

books.title: Hub users
books.summary: Using a hub: your profile, groups and projects, publications, resources, the wiki, forums, and courses.

books.title: Tools
books.summary: Publishing and running simulation tools: invoke scripts, the submit command, Jupyter, and administration.

books.title: Developers
books.summary: Components, plugins, modules, templates, the framework libraries, the API, and contributing a change.

books.title: Reference
books.summary: Generated from the source tree: configuration parameters, REST endpoints, console commands, and events.
